newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey searches for crew of sunken Russian boat.
newsitem.headline: Turkey searches for crew of sunken Russian boat.

text.p: Turkish gendarmerie forces scanned the horizon through rain and fog on Sunday in the search for seven missing crew members of a Russian-flagged passenger boat that sank in a Black Sea storm.
Local officials said ships or helicopters could not take part in the hunt for the Moldavia, which hit rocks and went down on Saturday night, because of large waves and heavy rain.
"We are looking out to sea with strong binoculars from positions along the coast," a gendarmerie officer told Reuters by telephone from the coastal town of Bartin.
He said seven crew members, all Turks were missing. Four people were rescued from the vessel, travelling from the eastern coastal city of Trabzon to Istanbul for repairs.
Anatolian news agency said a Turkish company had been renovating the Moldavia to turn it into a 300-bed floating hotel with a cinema. It had not been to sea for four years, the agency said.
